notes.title: “What is in the Black Box?” 1.0 - Game Release
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45312413/1f889391fe0244c51ed148e76a5ac7619e0f123f.png

Dear players and Steam Community members, our little game has taken the first step towards our vision.

What is in the Black Box? has become available for sale and now you can touch what kind of madness we tried to create for yourself

We wish you to guess the code of the black box and get your own unique piece of content.
